verdict.rationale: Trello's own marketing says it can "Automate tasks and workflows" (trello-docs-3), a first-party automation capability. However, the evidence gives no detail on how automations are configured, triggered or run unattended. Power-Up buttons, webhooks, the REST API and the MCP server are developer building blocks or manually triggered features, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of rule/trigger-based or scheduled automations, evidence that automations run autonomously in the background without user action, any AI-driven automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
